mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_as_student stu
stu.is_valid = 1 AND stu.register_status = 1 AND stu.student_identity_id IS NOT NULL
AND stu.school_id = #{query.schoolId}
AND (stu.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.queryInfo}, '%') OR stu.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.queryInfo}, '%'))
AND stu.term_id = #{query.termId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_as_student_identity si WHERE si.id = stu.student_identity_id AND si.is_valid = 1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_as_student_destination dest INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON dest.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE dest.student_id = stu.id AND dest.is_valid = 1 AND dest.destination_type = 1 AND svc.term_id = stu.term_id )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_as_student_destination d2 INNER JOIN t_as_course_session sd2 ON d2.session_id = sd2.id AND sd2.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc2 ON sd2.course_class_id = cc2.id AND cc2.is_valid = 1 WHERE d2.student_id = stu.id AND d2.is_valid = 1 AND d2.destination_type = 1 AND cc2.category_id = #{query.categoryId} )

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sd.session_date, '%Y年%m月') AS month, COUNT(distinct sd.id) AS lessonCount FROM t_as_course_session sd INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON sd.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE sd.is_valid = 1 and sd.session_status = 2 AND sd.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND svc.term_id = #{termId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sd.session_date, '%Y年%m月') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(sd.session_date, '%Y-%m') ASC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dest.student_id) FROM t_as_student_destination dest WHERE dest.is_valid = 1 AND dest.destination_type = 1 AND dest.session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT att.student_id) FROM t_as_attendance_record att WHERE att.is_valid = 1 AND att.session_id = #{sessionId} AND att.target_type = 1 AND att.attendance_status NOT IN (4, 5)

SELECT session_id AS sessionId, SUM(total_count) AS totalCount, SUM(attended_count) AS attendedCount FROM ( SELECT dest.session_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dest.student_id) AS total_count, 0 AS attended_count FROM t_as_student_destination dest WHERE dest.is_valid = 1 AND dest.destination_type = 1 AND dest.session_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY dest.session_id
UNION ALL
SELECT att.session_id, 0 AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT att.student_id) AS attended_count FROM t_as_attendance_record att WHERE att.is_valid = 1 AND att.target_type = 1 AND att.attendance_status NOT IN (4, 5) AND att.session_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY att.session_id ) combined GROUP BY session_id

SELECT stu.student_no AS studentNo, stu.student_name AS studentName, stu.gender AS gender, stu.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId, CONCAT( g.grade_name, ' ',cls.class_name) AS className, cls.enrollment_year AS enrollmentYear, term.id AS termId, term.term_name AS termName, term.start_date AS termStartDate, term.end_date AS termEndDate, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.id) AS totalLessonHours, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN att.id IS NOT NULL AND att.attendance_status NOT IN (4, 5) THEN sd.id END) AS attendanceHours, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN att.id IS NOT NULL AND att.attendance_status IN (4, 5) THEN sd.id END) AS absenceHours FROM t_as_student stu LEFT JOIN t_educl_class cls ON stu.class_id = cls.id AND cls.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_grade g ON g.id = stu.grade_id AND g.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_student_destination dest ON stu.id = dest.student_id AND dest.is_valid = 1 AND dest.destination_type = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_session sd ON dest.session_id = sd.id AND sd.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON sd.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_term term ON svc.term_id = term.id AND term.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_attendance_record att ON att.session_id = sd.id AND att.student_id = stu.id AND att.is_valid = 1 AND att.target_type = 1 WHERE stu.is_valid = 1 AND stu.id = #{studentId} AND stu.term_id = #{termId} AND svc.term_id = #{termId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_school_manage WHERE is_valid = 1

SELECT m.id AS id, m.news_name AS title, m.create_time AS publishDate, m.introduction AS introduction FROM t_portal_article_manage m WHERE m.is_valid = 1 AND m.article_type_id = #{articleTypeId} AND m.school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ea.total_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below60, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.total_score >= 60 AND ea.total_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS range60to69, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.total_score >= 70 AND ea.total_score < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS range70to79, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.total_score >= 80 AND ea.total_score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS range80to89, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.total_score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS range90to100 FROM t_as_evaluation_answer ea INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON ea.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE ea.is_valid = 1 AND ea.school_id = #{schoolId} AND ea.submit_status = 1 AND ea.target_teacher_id IS NOT NULL
AND svc.term_id = #{termId}

SELECT cs.session_date AS sessionDate, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, cc.applicable_grade_ids AS applicableGradeIds, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, cs.operate_attend_time AS operateAttendTime, cs.is_operate_attend AS isOperateAttend FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_teacher t ON cs.teacher_id = t.id AND t.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1
cs.is_valid = 1 and cs.session_status = 2
AND cs.school_id = #{query.schoolId}
AND t.teacher_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.teacherName}, '%')
AND cc.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND JSON_CONTAINS(cc.applicable_grade_ids, CAST(#{query.gradeId} AS JSON))
AND DATE(cs.session_date) BETWEEN DATE(#{query.sessionDateStart}) AND DATE(#{query.sessionDateEnd})
group by cs.id ORDER BY cs.session_date DESC

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ar.id) FROM t_as_attendance_record ar INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON ar.session_id = cs.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1 AND ar.attendance_status IN (1, 2, 3) AND ar.school_id = #{schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{termId} ) AS attendanceCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ar.id) FROM t_as_attendance_record ar INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON ar.session_id = cs.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1 AND cc.school_id = #{schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{termId} ) AS totalCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cc.id) FROM t_as_course_class cc INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE cc.is_valid = 1 AND cc.school_id = #{schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{termId} ) AS totalCourseCount

SELECT cc.id AS courseClassId, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL AND ar.attendance_status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN ar.id END) AS attendanceCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dest.id IS NOT NULL THEN dest.id END) AS totalCount FROM t_as_course_class cc INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_attendance_record ar ON ar.session_id = cs.id AND ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_student_destination dest ON dest.session_id = cs.id AND dest.is_valid = 1 WHERE cc.is_valid = 1 AND cc.school_id = #{schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{termId} GROUP BY cc.id

SELECT FLOOR(DATEDIFF(cs.session_date, #{startDate}) / 7) + 1 AS weekNum, CONCAT('第', FLOOR(DATEDIFF(cs.session_date, #{startDate}) / 7) + 1, '周') AS weekLabel, g.id AS gradeId, g.grade_name AS gradeName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL AND ar.attendance_status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN ar.id END) AS attendanceCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL THEN ar.id END) AS totalCount FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_attendance_record ar ON ar.session_id = cs.id AND ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_student stu ON ar.student_id = stu.id AND stu.is_valid = 1 AND stu.register_status = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_grade g ON stu.grade_id = g.id AND g.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cs.school_id = #{schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{termId} AND cs.session_date >= #{startDate} AND cs.session_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY weekNum, g.id ORDER BY weekNum ASC, g.id ASC

SELECT cc.id AS courseClassId, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, cc.applicable_grade_ids AS applicableGradeIds, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.id END) AS expectedAttendanceCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cs.id IS NOT NULL AND cs.session_status = 2 THEN cs.id END) AS finishedLessonCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL THEN ar.id END) = 0 THEN 0.00 ELSE ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL AND ar.attendance_status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN ar.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL THEN ar.id END), 2 ) END AS attendanceRateValue FROM t_as_course_class cc INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_teacher t ON cc.teacher_id = t.id AND t.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_enrollment en on en.course_class_id = cc.id and en.enroll_status = 3 and en.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_student s on s.id = en.student_id and en.is_valid = 1 and s.register_status = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_attendance_record ar ON ar.session_id = cs.id AND ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1
cc.is_valid = 1 AND cc.school_id = #{query.schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{query.termId}
AND (cc.course_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.queryInfo}, '%') OR t.teacher_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.queryInfo}, '%'))
GROUP BY cc.id HAVING ( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL THEN ar.id END) = 0 OR ( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL AND ar.attendance_status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN ar.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL THEN ar.id END) ) <= #{query.warningThreshold} ) ORDER BY attendanceRateValue DESC

SELECT COUNT(cs.id) AS totalSessions, COUNT(CASE WHEN cs.session_status = 2 THEN cs.id END) AS completedSessions, COUNT(CASE WHEN cs.session_status IN (0, 1) THEN cs.id END) AS remainingSessions FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cs.school_id = #{schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{termId}

SELECT cc.id AS courseClassId, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, cat.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(cs.id) AS totalSessions, COUNT(CASE WHEN cs.session_status = 2 THEN cs.id END) AS completedSessions, COUNT(CASE WHEN cs.session_status IN (0, 1) THEN cs.id END) AS remainingSessions, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, CASE WHEN NOW() < svc.course_start_date THEN 0 WHEN NOW() > svc.course_end_date THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS courseStatus FROM t_as_course_class cc INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 AND svc.service_status != 0 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_category cat ON cc.category_id = cat.id AND cat.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_teacher t ON cc.teacher_id = t.id AND t.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cs.is_valid = 1
cc.is_valid = 1 AND cc.school_id = #{query.schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{query.termId}
AND cc.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND (cc.course_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.queryInfo}, '%') OR t.teacher_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.queryInfo}, '%'))
GROUP BY cc.id
ORDER BY remainingSessions DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COUNT(cs.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(CASE WHEN cs.session_status = 2 THEN cs.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cs.id) END DESC
ORDER BY cc.create_time DESC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ea.total_score IS NOT NULL THEN ea.total_score END), 2) AS averageScore, COUNT(DISTINCT ea.id) AS totalEvaluationCount FROM t_as_evaluation_answer ea INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON ea.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE ea.is_valid = 1 AND ea.school_id = #{query.schoolId} AND ea.target_teacher_id IS NOT NULL AND ea.submit_status = 1 AND svc.term_id = #{query.termId}
AND cc.category_id = #{query.categoryId}

SELECT -- 学生总数：register_status=1 且 school_roll_status=1 ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM t_as_student s WHERE s.is_valid = 1 AND s.school_id = #{schoolId} AND s.term_id = #{termId} AND s.register_status = 1 AND s.school_roll_status = 1 ) AS totalStudentCount,
-- 课后课程数 ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cc.id) FROM t_as_course_class cc INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 WHERE cc.is_valid = 1 AND cc.school_id = #{schoolId} AND srv.term_id = #{termId} and srv.service_status != 0 ) AS totalCourseCount,
-- 参与报名的学生人数（用于计算学生参与率） ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) FROM t_as_enrollment e INNER JOIN t_as_student s on s.id = e.student_id and s.is_valid = 1 AND s.register_status = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON e.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 WHERE e.is_valid = 1 AND e.school_id = #{schoolId} AND srv.term_id = #{termId} ) AS enrolledStudentCount,
-- 学生出勤 ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status IN (1,2,3) THEN ar.id END) FROM t_as_attendance_record ar INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON cs.id = ar.session_id AND cs.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 WHERE ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1 AND ar.school_id = #{schoolId} AND srv.term_id = #{termId} ) AS stuAttendanceNum, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ar.id) FROM t_as_attendance_record ar INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON cs.id = ar.session_id AND cs.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 WHERE ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1 AND ar.school_id = #{schoolId} AND srv.term_id = #{termId} ) AS stuTotalAttendance,
-- 教师总数：在该学期有课程的教师 ( SELECT COUNT(t.id) FROM t_as_teacher t WHERE t.is_valid = 1 AND t.school_id = #{schoolId} AND t.register_status = 1 AND t.employee_status = 1 ) AS totalTeacherCount,
-- 教师出勤+课时 ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cs.teacher_id = cs.original_teacher_id THEN cs.id END) FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cs.session_status = 2 AND cs.school_id = #{schoolId} AND srv.term_id = #{termId} ) AS teacherAttendanceNum, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.id) FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cs.session_status = 2 AND cs.school_id = #{schoolId} AND srv.term_id = #{termId} ) AS teacherTotalAttendance, ( SELECT COUNT(cs.id) FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cs.school_id = #{schoolId} AND srv.term_id = #{termId} ) AS totalClassHourCount,
-- 教师平均分 ( SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ea.total_score), 2), 0) FROM t_as_evaluation_answer ea INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON ea.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 WHERE ea.is_valid = 1 AND ea.target_teacher_id is NOT NULL and ea.submit_status = 1 AND ea.school_id = #{schoolId} AND srv.term_id = #{termId} AND ea.total_score IS NOT NULL ) AS totalTeacherAverageScore

SELECT g.grade_name AS name, COUNT(s.id) AS value FROM t_as_student s INNER JOIN t_educl_grade g ON s.grade_id = g.id AND g.is_valid = 1 WHERE s.is_valid = 1 and s.register_status = 1 AND s.school_id = #{schoolId} AND s.term_id = #{termId} GROUP BY g.id

select c.category_name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT en.student_id) AS value from t_as_enrollment en INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc on cc.id = en.course_class_id and cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_category c on c.id = cc.category_id and c.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 where en.is_valid = 1 and en.enroll_status in (1,3) and en.school_id = #{query.schoolId} and srv.term_id = #{query.termId} GROUP BY cc.category_id

SELECT FLOOR(DATEDIFF(cs.session_date, #{startDate}) / 7) + 1 AS weekNum, CONCAT('第', FLOOR(DATEDIFF(cs.session_date, #{startDate}) / 7) + 1, '周') AS weekLabel, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cs.teacher_id = cs.original_teacher_id THEN cs.id END) AS attendanceCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cs.id IS NOT NULL THEN cs.id END) AS totalCount FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cs.school_id = #{schoolId} AND cs.session_status = 2 AND svc.term_id = #{termId} AND cs.session_date >= #{startDate} AND cs.session_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY weekNum ORDER BY weekNum ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS leaveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS earlyLeaveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentCount, CASE COUNT(*) WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END AS attendanceRate FROM t_as_attendance_record ar WHERE ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1 AND ar.student_id IN
#{id}

SELECT stu.id AS studentId, si.id AS studentIdentityId, stu.student_no AS studentNo, stu.student_name AS studentName, stu.term_id AS termId, term.term_name AS termName FROM t_as_student stu INNER JOIN t_as_student_identity si ON si.id = stu.student_identity_id AND si.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_term term ON stu.term_id = term.id
stu.is_valid = 1 AND stu.register_status = 1
AND stu.school_id = #{query.schoolId}
AND (stu.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.queryInfo}, '%') OR stu.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.queryInfo}, '%'))
AND stu.term_id = #{query.termId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_as_student_destination dest WHERE dest.student_id = stu.id AND dest.is_valid = 1 AND dest.destination_type = 1 AND dest.service_id IN ( SELECT svc.id FROM t_as_service svc WHERE svc.is_valid = 1 AND svc.term_id = stu.term_id ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_as_student_destination d2 INNER JOIN t_as_course_session sd2 ON d2.session_id = sd2.id AND sd2.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc2 ON sd2.course_class_id = cc2.id AND cc2.is_valid = 1 WHERE d2.student_id = stu.id AND d2.is_valid = 1 AND d2.destination_type = 1 AND cc2.category_id = #{query.categoryId} )
ORDER BY stu.student_no ASC
